SMTO-GWT-0065 — That power limit is outside what this GPU allows

GUID: 5a0dca89-5201-5242-939e-4dc3670d6c1c
Slug: gpu-power-limit-out-of-range
Domain: GWT · Subsystem: gpu

What happened

  • You asked for a power level lower or higher than this graphics card accepts right now. SMTO doesn't round it to the nearest allowed value, so nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the conversation, ask SMTO to show the power limits for this GPU. It lists the lowest and highest wattage the card accepts right now.
  2. Ask SMTO again to set the power limit, giving an exact number of watts between the lowest and highest values shown. SMTO only sets the exact value you choose, and only when it falls inside that range.
  3. If you were restoring the default power and still see this, ask the person who manages the GPU computer to check the card's limits. The card reported a default value outside its own current range, which SMTO won't apply.

What success looks like

  • SMTO confirms the new power limit and the GPU details show that value.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the computer with the GPU. Don't keep guessing nearby numbers; use the range SMTO shows.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The requested wattage (or the provider-reported default for restore_power_limit) lies outside the freshly observed hardware minimum/maximum power limits; values are never clamped.

What this means

  • The requested or restored-default wattage fell outside the freshly observed hardware minimum and maximum. The retained phase, target and receipt determine what executed. Rendering this definition adds no probe, retries, dispatch or changes to resource ownership.

Why this can happen

  • The requested or restored-default wattage fell outside the freshly observed hardware minimum and maximum.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare explicit watts with the retained current limits for the same UUID; no silent clamping is performed.

How to fix it

  • Read gpu.power_limits for the UUID (the error details also carry the observed power_limits) and resubmit set_power_limit with watts between minimum_watts and maximum_watts. If restore_power_limit fails, the reported default_watts lies outside the current range; inspect the device with nvidia-smi -q on the Gateway host.
  • Choose an explicit value within gpu.power_limits; values are never silently clamped.

Retry and execution caution

  • Choose an explicit value within gpu.power_limits; values are never silently clamped.

How to verify the fix

  • An explicitly chosen value falls within fresh limits and its applied state is confirmed.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations, kill GPU clients automatically or invent sensor values.

Technical notes

  • The retained phase, target and receipt determine what executed. Rendering this definition adds no probe, retries, dispatch or changes to resource ownership.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
